thread:
maria: Quick poll: unify SDKs around explicit prefetch modes and an opt-in fallback-to-stream for paginated endpoints. Need language ergonomics and safety constraints.

omar: Yes. Modes: none | adjacent (1 page) | buffered (N pages). Expose prefetch_pages and prefetch_bytes limits.

maria: Safety note: fallback-to-stream can change semantics (ordering, dedupe). Must be off by default and require server flag supports_streaming.

raj: Ops: prefetch must use its own retry/deadline and not consume main call retries. If prefetch fails, swallow and increment telemetry. If fallback triggers, surface as regular error path.

zoe: Go needs explicit iterator Close()/Cancel() to stop goroutines. Python/TS can hide it behind iterator protocol but provide an explicit close() too.

omar: Sample TS: const it = client.list({prefetch:'adjacent', prefetchPages:1, fallback:'stream'}); for await (const p of it) { /*...*/ }

maria: Telemetry: prefetch_attempts, prefetch_bytes, prefetch_failures, fallback_count, fallback_path. Link spans via parent_request_id.

raj: Defaults: Hosted = none, Dedicated/Private = adjacent. Admins can enforce org policy.

zoe: I'll prototype Go iterator cancel + bounded prefetch queue.

omar: I'll update transport layer to support background requests sharing connection pool and separate budgets.

maria: OK — I'll open an RFC PR with concrete method signatures and a compatibility table. If no objections by EOD we'll proceed.

ci-bot: CI green for branch "prefetch-unify-compact" (job #88).
